meta.title: Henle Latin Grammar — Part I: Forms
meta.source: Henle Latin Grammar, Part I: Forms (user-provided PDF)
meta.scope: Individual flashcards from structured form/paradigm tables in Part I. Prose-only rules are omitted. When a source table abbreviates with “etc.”, only forms explicitly printed in that table are made into cards.

verb_navigation.label: Active Voice
verb_navigation.note: Regular conjugations plus third-conjugation -iō active forms

verb_navigation.label: Passive Voice
verb_navigation.note: Regular conjugations plus third-conjugation -iō passive forms

meta.navigation_note: All Henle subsections share the same deck_id and progress. They are filters/views, not separate decks.
meta.direction_progress_note: Forward and reverse review histories are tracked separately while remaining in the same Henle deck.
meta.chart_study_status: Not yet implemented; reserved for consultation before creating a whole-chart study mode.
